==Description==
'''Accelerator Octopus Charm''' is an exclusive charm introduced in the [[Surf & Turf Battle Pass]] as a reward for reaching Level 34 on the premium track. It had a cost of {{BeachBalls|1,190}} or {{Robux|126}} to unlock it, with a total cost of {{BeachBalls|19,030}} or {{Robux|2,923}}. This item also has had two other costs. First one was the cost before its 20% discount, which had a cost of {{Robux|158}} with a total cost of {{Robux|3,672}}. The second was the price prior to the [[Surf & Turf Battle Pass]] individual skip cost fix, where it had a cost of {{Robux|98}}, with a total cost of {{Robux|2,810}}.

==Appearance==
'''Accelerator Octopus Charm''' appearance is based on the {{Color|Surf|Octopus}} [[Accelerator]] skin. The charm has the skin hold its hat with its arm. When used, it plays the sound of the {{Color|Surf|Octopus}} [[Accelerator]] skin's cooldown starting.

The color changes based on the player's username color, but appears orange in inventory preview.

==Trivia==
*The description for the charm states that the [[Accelerator]] tower is its own species rather than being human.
**It was most likely meant to say it is a rare subspecies of octopus instead of [[Accelerator]], though a mistake was made while writing the description.
